## Developer Guide

If you are new to using `nbdev` here are some useful pointers to get you started.

### Install estravon_bench in Development mode

``` sh
# make sure estravon_bench package is installed in development mode
$ pip install -e .

# make changes under nbs/ directory
# ...

# compile to have changes apply to estravon_bench
$ nbdev_prepare
```

## Usage

### Installation

Install latest from the GitHub [repository](https://github.com/tiberavonltd/estravon-backend-benchmarks):

``` sh
$ pip install git+https://github.com/tiberavonltd/estravon-backend-benchmarks.git
```

or from [conda](https://anaconda.org/tiberavonltd/estravon-backend-benchmarks)

``` sh
$ conda install -c tiberavonltd estravon_bench
```

or from [pypi](https://pypi.org/project/estravon-backend-benchmarks/)

``` sh
$ pip install estravon_bench
```

### Documentation

Documentation can be found hosted on this GitHub [repository](https://github.com/tiberavonltd/estravon-backend-benchmarks)’s [pages](https://tiberavonltd.github.io/estravon-backend-benchmarks/). Additionally you can find package manager specific guidelines on [conda](https://anaconda.org/tiberavonltd/estravon-backend-benchmarks) and [pypi](https://pypi.org/project/estravon-backend-benchmarks/) respectively.
